Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Markelle Fultz?

Markelle Fultz is 28 years old.

Where was Markelle Fultz born?

Markelle Fultz was born in Upper Marlboro, Maryland.

When was Markelle Fultz born?

Markelle Fultz was born on May 29, 1998.

How tall is Markelle Fultz?

Markelle Fultz is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much does Markelle Fultz weigh?

Markelle Fultz weighs 209 lbs (94 kg).

When was Markelle Fultz drafted?

Markelle Fultz was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Markelle Fultz play?

Point Guard and Shooting Guard.

What is Markelle Fultz's net worth?

Markelle Fultz has made at least $88,263,818 playing professional basketball.

How much does Markelle Fultz make?

Markelle Fultz made $17,000,000 in 2024.

What is Markelle Fultz's Instagram account?

Markelle Fultz is on Instagram at markellefultz.

What schools did Markelle Fultz attend?

Markelle Fultz attended DeMatha Catholic in Hyattsville, Maryland and Washington.

What are Markelle Fultz's nicknames?

Quick Wash, Kelle are nicknames for Markelle Fultz.
